author: A Robot
objectives: Identify the four chambers of the heart: right atrium, right ventricle, left atrium, left ventricle.
Identify the four heart valves: tricuspid, pulmonary (pulmonic), mitral (bicuspid), and aortic.
Identify major vessels entering and leaving the heart (superior and inferior vena cavae, pulmonary arteries and veins, aorta).
Describe the path of blood through the heart in the dual circulation (pulmonary and systemic circuits).
Explain the functional reason why the left ventricle has thicker myocardium than the right and how valves prevent backflow.

modules.description: Open with exterior view showing two heart models side-by-side: intact exterior heart and a cutaway exterior exposing the four chambers and major valves.
modules.author: A Robot
educationalObjectives: Recognize exterior landmarks of the heart and orient the organ in anatomical position.
Compare intact exterior anatomy with a cutaway view to locate interior structures.
instructions: Place two 3D heart models on the tabletop within a 0.8 m workspace centered on the user. One model remains intact; the other is a cutaway exposing interior chambers and valves.

components.text: Exterior orientation: left/right shown for viewer perspective.

clips.changeMeaning: Reveal both models and establish left-right orientation; apply gentle rotation to reveal key exterior landmarks.
clips.narration: Exterior view shows the heart oriented with apex pointing down and left. The intact heart sits to one side while the cutaway exposes interior chambers and valves.

clips.changeMeaning: Present a guiding label explaining the exterior orientation and the two models.
clips.narration: Labels appear indicating exterior landmarks and the orientation of the heart in the patient\'s frame.

clips.changeMeaning: Optional subtle reorientation for user navigation and comfort.
clips.narration: You can rotate both models to inspect from multiple angles.

clips.changeMeaning: Conclude scene and prepare transition to the interior tour.
clips.narration: Exterior inspection complete. Proceed to the cutaway interior tour.
